attestation: I read AGENTS.md §1 for orientation only and used the common, inventory, decisions and L1 briefs and the permitted C82 captures. I kept to the forbidden-reading list and encountered no earlier audit text or IDs. I reviewed native-resolution crops of all 194 first screens, all 492 indexed scroll frames, and all dedicated runtime screens. I scanned the matrix layout files and used larger crops and accessibility artifacts where the narrow crops showed something to investigate. I saved no friction note and started no browser, host, or daemon.
